A total of 18 teams contested the league, with [[ES Sétif]] as the defending champions. It started on August 6, 2009, and ended on May 31, 2010.{{Cite web |url=http://www.lnf.dz/cal1.html |title = Ligue Nationale de Football |access-date=2010-06-23 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100409132623/http://www.lnf.dz/cal1.html |archive-date=2010-04-09 |url-status=dead }} [[MC Alger]] were crowned champions, the seventh time in club history, on the final day of the season after a 4-0 win against [[MSP Batna]]. == Overview == === Promotion and relegation === '''Teams promoted from [[2008-09 Algerian Championnat National 2]]''' * [[CA Batna]] * [[MC Oran]] * [[WA Tlemcen]] '''Teams relegated to [[2009–10 Algerian Championnat National 2]]''' * [[MC Saïda]] * [[RC Kouba]] === Teams & Stadiums === {| class="wikitable sortable" |- !
